taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata (now Claytonia perfoliata): erect or spreading, 5 cm to 30 cm high.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: an annual, more or less fleshy and often reddish.

traits.rosette.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: several basal leaves on petioles.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: the two stem leaves united into a round or angled disk under the flowers; drawn as an opposite pair.

traits.shoot_leaves.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: the stem's one pair of leaves, united into a disk.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: basal leaves 1 cm to 7 cm long.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: the stem leaves joined into an orbicular disk; basal leaves spatulate or lanceolate to rhomboidal.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Hairless and fleshy, as the photos show: Abrams (1944 p. 127) names no hairs.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: flowers in congested or elongated racemes.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: petals 5, clawed, 3 mm to 4.5 mm long.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: petals 3 mm to 4.5 mm long, so the flower about twice that across.

traits.petal_apex.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: petals notched at the tip.

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: flowers pink or white; drawn white, as in most of the photos.

traits.fruit_type.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 127, Montia perfoliata: a globose capsule.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: flowering March to May.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: pale, fleshy green; the round stem-leaf disk and spoon-shaped basal blades a bright, slightly glaucous green.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for miner's lettuce from Abrams's description and the photos the traits cite: the herb program's structure (stems, nodes, basal leaves, how the flowers are borne). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.15 m tall at 1 years in the open, within the flora's range. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
